rules.name: Always Think Before Acting
rules.description: Unconditional pre_llm_call guard that forces a reasoning block before any response and between tool calls. The cheapest rule in the set and the one that catches the most: most bad agent turns are un-reasoned turns.

inject.context:
[HARD RULE: Always Think Before Acting]
Produce your reasoning before every response and before and after every tool call. Do not skip reasoning on turns that look simple — the turn that skips it is the one that fails.

rules.name: No Placeholders — Build It, Don't Stub
rules.description: Fires on any implementation context. Refuses stub functions, TODO bodies, fake fallbacks and 'phase 2' deferrals: build the missing piece, or say plainly that it is unbuilt.

inject.context:
[HARD RULE: No Placeholders]
Never ship a stub, a TODO body, a silently-degrading try/except, or a 'phase 2' deferral in place of working code. Build the real data path. If something genuinely cannot be built in this turn, say it is unbuilt — do not leave a fake that compiles.

rules.name: Verify Before Claiming
rules.description: pre_verify gate. Blocks completion while the turn's own tool output contradicts the claim, and reminds the agent to re-read its evidence instead of trusting a subagent's self-report.

inject.context:
[HARD RULE: Verify Before Claiming]
Before you report a thing as done, fixed, working or tested, point at the tool output that proves it in this turn. A subagent's summary is a claim, not evidence. A green test run is evidence only about what it actually compiled and ran.

rules.name: Read the Source, Not the Recollection
rules.description: Fires when a turn states a constant, limit, key name or API shape. Forces the value to come from the file or docs rather than from recall.

inject.context:
[HARD RULE: Read the Source]
Never state a limit, threshold, config key or API shape from memory. Read it from the file or the official docs in this turn, and quote where it came from. A remembered constant is a guess wearing a number.

rules.name: A Failing Tool Repeated Verbatim Means the Call Shape Is Wrong
rules.description: transform_tool_result guard. When an error repeats unchanged, the argument shape is wrong, not the value. Stops the retry loop that burns a turn.

inject.context:
[HARD RULE: Change the Shape, Not the Value]
A tool error that repeats verbatim means the call form is wrong. Do not retry it with different values. Change the tool, the argument shape, or the approach.

rules.name: A Disclosed Gap Is a Gap
rules.description: pre_verify gate against the limitations-list ending. Naming an unfinished piece as a caveat is not delivering it; build it, or state the next action already taken.

inject.context:
[HARD RULE: A Disclosed Gap Is a Gap]
A 'known limitations' section that names unfinished work and stops is delivery of something unfinished. Build it now, or present it as open work with the next action already taken — never as a conclusion.
